telegram.title: ZIAForge · joga doole kewal maa
telegram.helpBody:
/status — ngonka jaɓɓorgal
/projects — golle
/tasks [project-id] — gollal
/task task-id — ngonka e baɗe
/run task-id — fuɗɗor laaɓtude walla jokku gollal
/pause task-id — darta golle
/screenshot — nanngu henorde jaɓɓorgal ngal
/ask text — naamno wallitoowo cuɓaaɗo oo (walla neldu ɓataake)
/new {JSON} — sos gollal e kuutoragol createTask cifaaɗo
/command {"method":"...","args":[...]} — yamiroore API laaɓtunde

Jamirooje ceŋol e doole backend ina mbaɗa e kala yamiroore. Run jaɓataa dokimaa walla peewnugol. Pellitte ina njiɗi ID-ji hannde e waylitol. Ɓataakeeji neldaaɗi hade bot fuɗɗaade mbaɗataako.
